lines.cap: You let one go about fifteen times a day. Everyone does.
lines.say: You let one go about fifteen times a day. Everyone does.

lines.cap: Yes, even the quiet person at the next desk.
lines.say: Yes, even the quiet person at the next desk.

lines.cap: Most of it is just air you swallow. Eating fast, chewing gum, fizzy drinks.
lines.say: Most of it is just air you swallow. Eating fast, chewing gum, fizzy drinks.

lines.cap: The rest comes from bacteria in your gut, feasting on food you couldn't digest.
lines.say: The rest comes from bacteria in your gut, feasting on food you couldn't digest.

lines.cap: Beans, onions and broccoli feed them the most. So they make more gas.
lines.say: Beans, onions and broccoli feed them the most. So they make more gas.

lines.cap: Less than one percent of it smells. A tiny bit of sulphur does all the damage.
lines.say: Less than one percent of it smells. A tiny bit of sulphur does all the damage.

lines.cap: Holding it in doesn't make it disappear. It just waits, and comes out later.
lines.say: Holding it in doesn't make it disappear. It just waits, and comes out later.

lines.cap: So don't be embarrassed. Your gut is just doing its job.
lines.say: So don't be embarrassed. Your gut is just doing its job.
